Bulk-upload workflow

  1. Open Master data; download the template for the required category.
  2. Fill the exact headings. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD text or Excel serial values. Employee/Consultant, scope names and form purposes use the choices in the template notes.
  3. Select Bulk upload Excel. For resources, also select all actual files whose names appear in File Name.
  4. Select Validate upload. Review each Excel row and its errors. No data is saved by preview.
  5. Select Save validated upload. All rows are revalidated against current data and permission. The POC saves the complete list only when valid.

Validation and access

Trainer codes must be unique; availability must reference an existing trainer and have valid ordered dates; holiday scopes require the corresponding state/project; resources/forms must reference a plan belonging to the selected project. Day numbers must be within plan duration. Duplicate additions are blocked using the documented import identity contract. Only permitted trainers can upload resources; trainers cannot propagate them to existing batches without administrator review.

Forms become available on their linked training day and remain accessible until project end. Comma-separated days support daily/periodic feedback. Existing-batch inclusion remains an explicit per-link choice. Common resources can be reused across projects through the existing resource-link controls.

Review boundaries

Imports add records; they do not overwrite existing master rows. Availability changes/removal may expose conflicts on existing assignments; schedules are not silently moved. Historical assignment imports are separate references and do not create batches. State names use exact text matching with the school directory. The form POC uses one question and demo exact-match assessment scoring. Bulk resources use filenames and extension validation; file scanning and full form designer are outside this POC.

Excel parsing uses the first worksheet; binary XLS is not implemented. Actual resource bytes use IndexedDB; metadata uses browser storage. Secure server permissions, transactional multi-user saves, durable audit and shared files need a backend. Browser UI, actual workbook parsing in a browser and actual IndexedDB remain unverified; tests use fixtures plus generated XLSX structure checks.

Run the complete POC

Extract the ZIP, run python -m http.server 8080 from a terminal in that folder, and open http://localhost:8080/. Select Schoolnet Admin to review all master controls. The previous project, plan, batch, registration, attendance, resource and certificate modules are retained.
